L0: # Overview
L1: 
L2: Model your business on Stripe with products and prices.
L3: 
L4: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L5: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L6: 
L7: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L8: 
L9: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L10: ## Get started
L11:

L15: ## Pricing models
L16: 
L17: [Flat rate (good-better-best)](https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models.md#flat-rate): Offer your customers a choice of escalating options, like basic, starter, and Enterprise service levels
L18: 
L19: [Per-seat](https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models.md#per-seat): Let your customers pick how many seats or licenses they’ll use and bill them for each.
L20: [Usage-based](https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models.md#usage-based-pricing): Charge your customers based on how much of your service they use during the billing period.
